title: Labels
intro: The only labels catalog files may carry. Administrators define each label's key, its allowed values, and the entity kinds it applies to.

field.keyHint: Optional lowercase domain prefix, a slash, then the name — e.g. example.com/tier
field.valuesHint: The closed list a file may pick from — press Enter to add each value
field.kindsHint: Only files of these kinds may carry this label

validation.key: Must be an optional lowercase-domain prefix plus a 1–63 character name of letters, digits, and single [-_.] separators
validation.valuesRequired: Add at least one allowed value
validation.value: Value "{{value}}" must be 1–63 alphanumeric characters with single [-_.] separators

saveConflict: A label with this key already exists
saveInvalid: One or more fields are invalid
saveGone: This label no longer exists — reload the page
deleteBody: Files carrying "{{key}}" will not save until the label is re-registered or removed from them.
